title: SOPO: Socratic Guided Policy Optimization for Span-Level Hallucination Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.32212v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have gained widespread adoption in various natural language processing tasks, but suffer from hallucination issues where they generate unfaithful or inconsistent content. While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown promising applications in reasoning tasks, its application to span-level hallucination detection is challenged by localization ambiguity, reward sparsity on hard examples, and uncontrolled length inflation. translated_title: SOPO：苏格拉底引导的策略优化用于片段级幻觉检测
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）已在各种自然语言处理任务中得到广泛应用，但存在幻觉问题，即生成不忠实或不一致的内容。虽然可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）在推理任务中展现出有前景的应用，但将其应用于片段级幻觉检测面临定位模糊性、困难样本奖励稀疏以及不受控的长度膨胀等挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了苏格拉底引导的策略优化（SOPO），这是一个用于鲁棒幻觉检测的多轮强化学习框架。SOPO的关键创新在于苏格拉底反馈机制，其中教师模型通过提供从真实标签推断出的间接提示，在采样过程中引导推理轨迹。这种教师引导的方法使模型能够为困难样本生成更有效的推理轨迹，从而缓解奖励稀疏问题。
tldr: SOPO提出了一种苏格拉底引导的多轮强化学习框架，通过教师模型提供基于真实标签的间接提示来引导推理轨迹，从而解决片段级幻觉检测中的定位模糊、困难样本奖励稀疏和长度膨胀问题。
en_tdlr: SOPO is a multi-turn RL framework for span-level hallucination detection that employs a Socratic feedback mechanism, where a teacher model provides indirect hints derived from ground truth to guide reasoning trajectories, alleviating localization ambiguity, reward sparsity on hard examples, and length inflation.
